ntTimeTracker.tracking.idleTimeoutSecond.description: Safety cap: seconds a focused window keeps counting with no editor activity before tracking stops. Reading or reviewing (with no edits) still counts up to this cap; beyond it a focused-but-idle window stops. Any activity resumes tracking. Default 300 (5 min), matching tools like Clockify and Paymo. Set 0 to disable the cap and track continuously while the window is focused — useful for long interactive CLI/agent sessions (e.g. Claude Code) the editor sees no activity in.

ntTimeTracker.tracking.focusLossToleranc.description: Seconds a look-away (VS Code losing focus) is tolerated before the work segment closes; the status bar shows 'tracking (grace)' during this window.

ntTimeTracker.solidtime.organizationId.description: SolidTime organization id. Leave blank to use your first organization.

ntTimeTracker.timetagger.apiUrl.markdownDescription: TimeTagger server URL. Leave as the public app, or point to a self-hosted instance. The extension only sends to TimeTagger when a TimeTagger API token is set.
